edit_without_running: To change these values WITHOUT running the template (e.g. to show the edited workflow), call apply_slots with `workflow` set to get_template's `workflow_json` and `overrides` keyed by the `address` of the entries that carry no `route`; it returns the edited workflow and runs nothing. To run with the same values, pass them to run_template as `slot_overrides`. get_template is itself capped: a very large template returns a bounded node summary instead of `workflow_json` — for one of those, use the run_template route. Most declared addresses resolve, but one the instance promotes from its own container is refused with `interior node -1 not found in subgraph` (a known engine defect) — for that entry use run_template `input_overrides` keyed by the slot's `node_id` instead.
